channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Ladies proposal to trial 12 playing rule enhancements ratified by Central Council
item.description: The Ladies Gaelic Football Association has confirmed that a package of 12 playing rule enhancementswill be trialled during the 2026 Lidl National Football League season and Higher Education Colleges competitions.

item.title: Dr. Harty Cup History Book launched
item.description: The first ever history of the Dr. Harty Cup, which has been contested annually since 1918 has been launched.

item.title: All-Ireland Club football semi-final fixtures details revealed
item.description: The GAA has announced the times, dates and venues for the All-Ireland Club football semi-finals.

item.title: McBrearty retires from Donegal duty
item.description: Donegal captain Paddy McBrearty has announced his retirement from intercounty football.

item.title: Quillinan takes Glenflesk reins
item.description: Former Kerry minor boss Wayne Quillinan has been appointed as Glenflesk's new intermediate football manager.

item.title: AFL-bound McDonald makes Mayo senior debut
item.description: Teenage sensation Kobe McDonald made his senior debut for Mayo in a challenge match against Meath last weekend.

item.title: Ryan recalled by Limerick
item.description: Reigning Poc Fada champion Colin Ryan has been recalled to the Limerick senior hurling panel after a six-year absence.

item.title: Sligo man Murphy to run for GAA president
item.description: Sligo's John Murphy has joined Derek Kent (Wexford) and Ger Ryan (Tipperary) in the race to become the next GAA president.

item.title: Looney and Wall join AFLW exodus
item.description: Cork's Hannah Looney and Sarah Wall from Meath have become the latest ladies football stars to sign for AFLW clubs.

item.title: O'Neill joins Tyrone U20 management
item.description: Tyrone U20 football boss Paul Devlin has added Stephen O'Neill to his backroom team.
